x-status: BID-ADR-022 approved; mutation routes are implemented and composed but not functionally verified

delete.summary: Revoke one other active browser session
delete.description: Account owner only. Requires exact Origin, session-bound CSRF, a session created within 15 minutes and UUID idempotency. Cross-user, missing, expired and already-revoked targets return generic 204; the current session returns 409.

post.summary: Revoke all active sessions including the caller
post.description: Account owner only. Atomically advances auth epoch, revokes at most 100 active current-epoch sessions, records minimal evidence and clears session/CSRF cookies without replacement.

204.description: All active sessions revoked and cookies cleared
